notes.title: Calling all Beta Testers :) We appriciate you!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Andrew here, would you like to be on the beta-test for DOTRS?  

I am getting close to running the first beta, and I only need 10 people.  As you may already know this is a solo project, so I can only do a small sample size at a time.  

Reach out here or on the discord - https://discord.gg/eu2ErB2mek

Thank you!

Andrew
